assessment.headline: DAY 39. Trump rejected ceasefire. Deadline TONIGHT. Green Asha crossed — India almost fully extracted. The decision moment.
assessment.body:
Trump rejected the 45-day ceasefire proposal as 'not good enough' — but called it 'significant.' His deadline for Iran to reopen the Strait of Hormuz expires TONIGHT at 8 PM ET (Wednesday 5:30 AM IST). His warning at Monday's press conference: 'The entire country can be taken out in one night, and that night might be tomorrow night.'

Iran sent its 10-point counter-proposal via Pakistan: Hormuz safe passage protocol, lifting of sanctions, reconstruction, ending regional conflicts, and a PERMANENT end to the war — not a temporary ceasefire. Iran rejects truces that allow the US/Israel to 'pause and prepare.' Mediators include Pakistan, Egypt, Qatar, Oman. Pope Leo, EU's Costa, Indian FM Jaishankar all pushing for diplomacy.

INDIA'S BIG WIN — GREEN ASHA CROSSED:
The 8th Indian LPG tanker has successfully transited the Strait of Hormuz. Reuters confirmed via LSEG and Kpler ship tracking. Green Asha is the first MID-SIZE gas carrier (MGC) to cross — all previous 7 were Very Large Gas Carriers (VLGCs). Only one Indian LPG vessel remains awaiting clearance: Jag Vikram.

This means India has extracted nearly its entire LPG fleet from the Hormuz war zone BEFORE the potential Tuesday strikes. If Trump bombs power plants tonight, Iran retaliates on Hormuz, and the strait becomes a full combat zone — India will have already secured its critical fuel supply.

ADDITIONAL INDIA HIGHLIGHTS:
• Jaishankar-Araghchi call: 'India supports ongoing efforts to stop war'
• Qatar PM also called India in mediation outreach
• Petroleum Ministry: 51 LAKH LPG cylinders delivered Mon (95% online bookings)
• 'No shortages at distributor points'
• 345 Indian fishermen returned from Iran (separate evacuation)
• Oil India ramping up Rajasthan/Thar desert crude production
• Sea Bird (Iranian LPG) discharged at Mangalore — India buying Iranian fuel
• Sensex closed +800 Monday on ceasefire hope (~73,800)
• Rupee strengthened to ~93 vs USD on RBI intervention + oil company dollar inflows
• Indian basket likely $118+ (Brent at $108.67)

WAR INTENSIFYING:
• Iran claims struck US amphibious assault ship LHA7 — 'forced retreat to southern Indian Ocean' (US not confirmed)
• 15 Americans injured at Ali Al Salem Air Base, Kuwait
• 373 US troops wounded total (up from 365)
• Israel killed 2 IRGC senior commanders + IRGC undercover unit leader
• Israel struck South Pars petrochemical plant (Asaluyeh)
• 4 killed in Israel by Iranian missiles (Haifa residential building strike)
• Saudi Aramco hiked Asia oil price to RECORD premium — extraordinary signal
• Eurasia Group: 'months to repair refineries even if ceasefire'

THE NEXT 35 HOURS:
• Tonight 5:30 AM IST Wed = Trump deadline expires
• If deal: Brent crashes to $78, Sensex rallies past 82,000
• If strikes: Brent past $140, Sensex crashes below 60,000, full crisis
• If extension: more uncertainty, oil holds $108-115

India enters this crucial day in the strongest possible strategic position: 8 LPG tankers extracted, fuel supply holding, diplomatic channels active with Iran, US, and mediators. Whatever happens tonight, India is prepared. The question is whether the world is ready for what comes next.
